title: Mulheres na praça, saúde de graça: relato de experiência da equipe multiprofissional
author: Elis Sales Muniz Lima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bay4ifyw

steps.title: Establish a Multiprofessional Team
steps.instruction: Assemble a diverse team of health professionals to lead the women's group, ensuring an integrated approach to care.

substeps.instruction: Include professionals from the Family Health Strategy (ESF) such as nurses, community health agents, and dentists.
Include the multiprofessional team from the Family Health Support Nucleus (NASF), which may consist of social assistants, physical educators, pharmacists, psychologists, and others.

steps.title: Schedule and Locate Group Meetings
steps.instruction: Organize weekly meetings in accessible community spaces to move health education beyond traditional institutional walls.

substeps.instruction: Set meetings to occur once a week, preferably on Tuesdays.
Utilize the neighborhood square (Praça do Bairro Tamarindo) as the primary location.
Allow participants to choose alternative locations, such as the neighborhood Residents' Association.

steps.title: Plan and Execute Health Activities
steps.instruction: Develop a flexible program of health promotion and disease prevention activities based on the participants' interests.

substeps.instruction: Determine themes and methodologies for the current meeting during the previous meeting through collaboration between participants and the team.
Implement ludic (playful) activities focused on self-care.
Conduct lectures on Women's Health and other requested topics.
Create a schedule (cronograma) for the encounters to organize the flow of activities.

steps.title: Monitor and Document Progress
steps.instruction: Systematically record all activities and patient interactions to evaluate the impact of the group and ensure continuity of care.

substeps.instruction: Maintain detailed diaries of the experiences.
Develop and update service maps for patient care.
Register all activities and clinical findings in patient medical records (prontuários).

steps.title: Evaluate and Refine Methodology
steps.instruction: Perform periodic evaluations of the topics addressed and the methodologies used to ensure the group remains resolutive and consistent.
